method: decision-point replay against ground truth; real transcript 400budnp ('Analyse the data of ReixachGCO', 188 tool-call turns). At 12 sampled turns, feed the model the real recorded context (bounded to system+first-user+last-28-msgs, each truncated) and force its next tool (tool_choice:required), once with the shipped MEGA tool descriptions, once with MINIMAL (first sentence, ~140 chars each). Model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731.

summary.note: Minimal matches ground truth EXACTLY as often as mega (7/12). 7/12 is roughly this method's ceiling — even mega (same descriptions as the real run) only hits 7/12, because forced tool_choice + a truncated window + temperature can't reproduce the real thinking-then-act trajectory. So both regimes hit the ceiling; cutting descriptions 93% did not lower tool-selection accuracy.
